Button.description: Primary interactive element for actions and navigation with multiple variants and sizes

variant.description: Visual style variant of the button

iconOnly.description: Whether button contains only an icon (makes it circular)

...props.description: All standard HTML button attributes (onClick, disabled, type, etc.)

variants.primary: Main CTAs, primary actions, submit buttons
variants.ghost: Subtle actions, icon buttons, menu items

accessibility: Use semantic button type (button, submit, reset)
Focus visible with ring on keyboard navigation
Button.whenToUse: For any user action: form submission, navigation, triggering actions, opening modals
Button.whenNotToUse: For navigation to external pages (use <a> tag), for non-interactive labels (use Badge)

Card.description: Container component for grouping related content with consistent elevation and structure

CardHeader.description: Top section for titles and descriptions

CardFooter.description: Bottom section for actions or metadata

Card.baseStyle: rounded-lg border border-border bg-card text-card-foreground shadow-sm

withFooter.description: Card with action buttons in footer

accessibility: Use semantic heading levels inside CardTitle
Interactive cards should have hover states
Card.whenToUse: Grouping related content, creating visual sections, listing items
Card.whenNotToUse: For single pieces of text (use div), for navigation items (use nav)

Input.description: Form input field with support for icons and various input types

leftIcon.description: Icon element to display on the left inside input

rightIcon.description: Icon element to display on the right inside input

Input.baseStyle: flex h-10 w-full rounded-md border border-input bg-transparent px-3 py-2 text-body
accessibility: Use proper type attribute for mobile keyboards
Provide placeholder as hint, not instruction
Use aria-label if no visible label
Error messages should be associated with aria-describedby
Input.whenToUse: Text input, email, password, search, number fields
Input.whenNotToUse: For dropdowns (use Select), for boolean (use Checkbox), for dates needing calendar (consider date picker)

Select.description: Dropdown select input for choosing from multiple options

children.description: Option elements to display in dropdown

...props.description: All standard HTML select attributes (value, onChange, etc.)

Select.baseStyle: flex h-10 w-full rounded-md border border-input bg-transparent px-3 py-2 text-body

usage.controlled: <Select value={value} onChange={(e) => setValue(e.target.value)}><option value="all">All Categories</option><option value="food">Food</option></Select>

accessibility: First option can be placeholder with empty value
Select.whenToUse: Selecting from 5+ options, categorical choices, filters
Select.whenNotToUse: For 2-4 options (use radio buttons), for boolean (use Checkbox), for searchable lists (consider custom dropdown)

Checkbox.description: Checkbox input for boolean selections or multi-select scenarios

label.description: Optional label text displayed next to checkbox

...props.description: All standard HTML input checkbox attributes

Checkbox.baseStyle: h-4 w-4 rounded border-input text-primary focus:ring-2 focus:ring-ring
accessibility: Use label prop or wrap in <label> with htmlFor
Checkbox must have associated label text
Keyboard focusable with space to toggle
Use in fieldset with legend for groups
Checkbox.whenToUse: Boolean choices, multi-select filters, feature toggles, agreeing to terms
Checkbox.whenNotToUse: For single choice from multiple options (use radio), for on/off toggle (consider switch)

Badge.description: Small label component for displaying status, categories, or metadata
Badge.baseStyle: inline-flex items-center rounded-md px-2.5 py-0.5 text-small font-semibold
Badge.whenToUse: Status indicators, categories, tags, counts, small labels
Badge.whenNotToUse: For actions (use Button), for long text (use regular text), for emphasis (use Typography)

Alert.description: Notification component for displaying important messages and feedback
Alert.whenToUse: Form errors, success messages, important notifications, warnings
Alert.whenNotToUse: For static information (use Card), for navigation (use links), for temporary toasts (consider toast component)

Tabs.description: Tab navigation component for switching between related content sections
Tabs.whenToUse: Switching between related content views, organizing content sections
Tabs.whenNotToUse: For page navigation (use links), for forms with steps (use stepper), for filters (use FilterChip)

Avatar.description: Display user profile image or fallback initials
accessibility: Fallback shows first letter or initials
Avatar.whenToUse: User profiles, comment authors, team members, owner info
Avatar.whenNotToUse: For business logos (use img), for decorative images (use img with alt="")

Skeleton.description: Loading placeholder that mimics content structure with animated pulse

className.description: Custom classes to set dimensions and shape

usage.heading: <Skeleton className="h-8 w-3/4" />
usage.card: <Card><CardHeader><Skeleton className="h-6 w-1/2 mb-2" /><Skeleton className="h-4 w-3/4" /></CardHeader><CardContent><Skeleton className="h-4 w-full mb-2" /><Skeleton className="h-4 w-full mb-2" /><Skeleton className="h-4 w-2/3" /></CardContent></Card>

patterns.listingCardSkeleton: Skeleton for ListingCard with image, title, description
patterns.profileSkeleton: Skeleton for user profile with avatar and info

accessibility: Replace with real content when loaded
Skeleton.whenToUse: Data loading states, slow API responses, optimistic UI
Skeleton.whenNotToUse: For immediate loads (show content directly), for errors (use Alert)

Pagination.description: Page navigation component with previous/next and numbered page buttons

maxVisible.description: Maximum page buttons to show before ellipsis

behavior.ellipsis: Shows ... when total pages exceeds maxVisible
behavior.boundaries: Always shows first and last page
behavior.disabled: Previous disabled on first page, Next disabled on last page

usage.withState:
const [page, setPage] = useState(1);
<Pagination currentPage={page} totalPages={totalPages} onPageChange={setPage} />

Pagination.whenToUse: Below list views, search results, data tables
Pagination.whenNotToUse: For small datasets (show all), for infinite scroll (use different pattern)

FilterChip.description: Chip component for filters with active state, dropdown indicator, and close button

active.description: Whether chip is in active state

FilterChipGroup.description: Container for multiple filter chips with proper spacing

usage.closeable: <FilterChip label="Open Now" active showClose onClose={() => removeFilter()} />

accessibility: Close action doesn't propagate to chip click
FilterChip.whenToUse: Filter bars, tag selection, category chips, active filters display
FilterChip.whenNotToUse: For static tags (use Badge), for navigation (use Tabs)

StatusCard.description: Colored card for displaying status messages with icon support

variants.warning: Amber tones for warnings or cautions

usage.withDetails: <StatusCard variant="success" title="Profile complete" icon={<CheckCircle />}>Your profile is now visible to users.</StatusCard>

StatusCard.whenToUse: Status notifications, informational banners, contextual messages
StatusCard.whenNotToUse: For form validation (use Alert), for navigation (use links)

MetaItem.description: Small inline metadata item with optional icon

icon.description: Icon element to display before text

usage.group: }>9 AM - 5 PM}>501-1234

MetaItem.whenToUse: Timestamps, locations, phone numbers, small metadata display
MetaItem.whenNotToUse: For prominent information (use InfoStat), for labels (use Badge)

InfoStat.description: Display a statistic or metric with icon, label, and value

icon.description: Icon element displayed in circular container

usage.tones: } label="Equipment" value="50+ Items" tone="primary" />} label="Classes" value="20/Week" tone="accent" />} label="Hours" value="6 AM - 10 PM" tone="muted" />

InfoStat.whenToUse: Dashboard metrics, key statistics, highlighted numbers
InfoStat.whenNotToUse: For small metadata (use MetaItem), for status (use StatusCard)

ThemeToggle.description: Toggle component for switching between light and dark themes

variants.switch: Toggle switch UI with sliding indicator

behavior.icons: Sun for light mode, Moon for dark mode

ThemeToggle.whenToUse: In header, settings panel, user preferences

PhotoUpload.description: Drag-and-drop file upload component for images

hint.default: or click to browse • JPG, PNG up to 5MB each

PhotoUpload.baseStyle: Dashed border, muted background, hover states

usage.custom: <PhotoUpload label="Upload business photos" hint="Max 10 photos, 5MB each" />

accessibility: Should be clickable to open file dialog
PhotoUpload.whenToUse: Uploading images, business photos, profile pictures
PhotoUpload.whenNotToUse: For non-image files (adapt component), for single click upload (use Input type=file)

SidePanel.description: Sliding panel that appears from the right side of the screen

behavior.animation: Slides in from right with 300ms transition
behavior.responsive: Full width on mobile, 400px on desktop

accessibility: Focus trapped within panel when open
SidePanel.whenToUse: Details views, forms, filters, additional info
SidePanel.whenNotToUse: For critical actions (use modal), for navigation (use Sidebar)

ListingCard.description: Card component displaying business listing preview with image, details, and metadata
composition: CardHeader with business name and category
CardContent with description, address, phone, hours, tags

usage.grid: {businesses.map(b => )}

ListingCard.whenToUse: Search results, listing grids, featured business sections
ListingCard.whenNotToUse: For detailed view (use full page), for admin list (use simplified card)

BusinessInfoCard.description: Card displaying structured business information (address, phone, website, capacity)

usage.basic: <BusinessInfoCard addressLines={['123 Main St', 'San Pedro, Belize']} phone="501-1234" website="https://example.com" capacity="50 people" />

BusinessInfoCard.whenToUse: Business detail pages, gym/restaurant info sections
BusinessInfoCard.whenNotToUse: For list views (too detailed), for cards without structured info

BusinessHoursCard.description: Card displaying business hours for each day of the week
BusinessHoursCard.whenNotToUse: For simplified displays (use text), for always-open businesses

VerificationBadge.description: Badge indicating verified or premium business status
VerificationBadge.whenToUse: Verified businesses, premium listings, certified providers
VerificationBadge.whenNotToUse: For status indicators (use Badge), for regular tags

BizListingPreviewCard.description: Preview card for business listing in admin/owner views
BizListingPreviewCard.usage: Admin and owner dashboards for managing listings
BizListingPreviewCard.whenToUse: Admin review queue, owner dashboard, listing management

BusinessMeta.description: Display business metadata in a consistent format
BusinessMeta.whenToUse: Business cards, listing details, metadata sections

LastUpdatedStamp.whenToUse: Admin views, owner dashboards, content management

LevelBadges.description: Display skill level badges (e.g., Beginner, Intermediate, Advanced)
LevelBadges.whenToUse: Gym listings, class schedules, fitness programs

FitnessHighlightCard.description: Highlight card for fitness business features
FitnessHighlightCard.whenToUse: Gym detail pages, fitness center showcases

TrainerGrid.description: Grid layout for displaying multiple trainers
TrainerGrid.whenToUse: Gym detail pages with multiple trainers

BizListingForm.whenToUse: Create listing page, edit listing page, admin management

BizListingLayout.description: Layout wrapper for business listing detail pages
BizListingLayout.whenToUse: Business detail pages with consistent layout

Sidebar.description: Fixed left navigation sidebar with grouped navigation items

isOpen.description: Whether sidebar is open (for mobile toggle)

structure.sections: Navigation items grouped by section with headings
structure.responsive: Slides out on mobile, fixed on desktop

Sidebar.whenNotToUse: For content navigation (use Tabs), for mobile-only nav (consider bottom nav)

Header.description: Top header bar with page title, theme toggle, and user actions
Header.whenToUse: Every page as consistent top navigation
Header.whenNotToUse: For landing pages without app chrome

FoodHero.description: Hero section for restaurant detail pages
FoodHero.whenToUse: Restaurant detail pages, food listing headers

FoodSidebar.description: Sidebar for restaurant information and actions
FoodSidebar.whenToUse: Restaurant detail pages with persistent info

FoodMenuSection.description: Display restaurant menu section with items

FoodQuickInfoRow.description: Quick info row for restaurant (cuisine, price range, etc.)

BusinessCard.description: Admin view of business for review queue

FilterBar.description: Filter bar for admin lists with search and filters
FilterBar.whenToUse: Admin list pages, filterable data tables

BulkActionsBar.description: Bulk action toolbar for selected items

forms.description: Form patterns using Input, Select, Checkbox, Button components

lists.description: List patterns using responsive grids and cards
lists.empty: Empty state message when no items

dashboards.description: Dashboard layouts with metrics and data
dashboards.layout: Grid of metric cards, followed by detailed sections

compositionGuide.principle: Build complex UIs from simple primitives

ListingCard.pattern: Combine Card structure with business data rendering

guidelines: Always use UI primitives from src/components/ui/
Domain components compose primitives, don't reimplement
Extract repeated patterns into new primitives

quickReference.findingComponents: Use component index to locate by name, search by category
quickReference.checkingAPI: Each component documents props with types, defaults, descriptions
quickReference.usage: Every component includes usage examples with code
quickReference.accessibility: Accessibility guidelines listed for each component
quickReference.whenToUse: Clear guidance on appropriate use cases

beforeBuilding: Search component index for existing components
Check if similar component exists in same category
Review composition patterns before creating new components
Use primitives from ui/ category when possible
whileBuilding: Follow prop patterns from existing components
Include TypeScript types for all props
afterBuilding: Test in both light and dark themes
